units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 38:9">Ex. R. s. 38</cite>, end <he>על ס׳ היה וכ׳</he> on the sapphire (in the high priest’s breastplate) the name of Issachar was engraven. Pesik. ‘Ăniya, p. 135ᵇ <he>נבקע … והס׳ לא חסר</he> the anvil was split, the hammer was broken in two, but the sapphire remained intact.
